segments.name: Drug Development
segments.description: Clinical-stage development of cannabinoid-based drugs for Tourette syndrome, Alzheimer's disease and agitation, autism spectrum disorder and status epilepticus.
segments.evidence: We are currently engaged in the following development programs based on THC and/or non-psychoactive CBD: SCI-110 for the treatment of TS and for the treatment of Alzheimer's disease and agitation; and SCI-210 for the treatment of ASD and SE.

segments.name: Online Sales
segments.description: Online sales of hemp-based and other beauty and hair treatment products manufactured in the United States, sold on Amazon Marketplace.
segments.evidence: (2) online sales of a various range of hemp-based products including hemp gummies, hemp oil capsules, hemp gel, hemp cream, detox pills, height pills, antibacterial creams, and anti-aging creams, among other beauty and hair treatment products that are all manufactured in the United States.

revenueModel.text: The company earns revenue from online sales of hemp-based products to consumers, while the drug development segment generated no external revenue.
